name: Website Tour Video
summary: Turn a real website into a visual tour video using captured page states and a time-coded story sequence.
problem: A website tour needs to show real page design and interactions while turning browsing into a paced, coherent video narrative.
coreOutcomes: Capture the relevant website states and interactions
Plan a visual sequence and narration from the site
Build and validate the HyperFrames tour composition
requirements: Browser access for capture and a HyperFrames project
boundaries: Use for general website tours and showcases, not product-launch marketing or topic explainers
Respect site access controls and media licensing; do not claim inaccessible pages were captured
